name: Tongyu Advanced Materials (Guangdong) Co., LTD
summary: Tongyu Advanced Materials (Guangdong) Co., LTD engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electronic resins in China. It offers systematic resin solutions for semiconductor packaging materials, printed circuit board inks, and electronic adhesives, as well as the mid-to-high-end copper clad laminate industry. The company also provides MDI modified epoxy, high brominated epoxy, DOPO modified epoxy, phosphorus containing hardener, benzoxazine, BPA type novolac epoxy, and malemide resins. Tongyu Advanced Materials (Guangdong) Co., LTD was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Zhaoqing, China.
